item.description:
## New Features
- Overview card titles use matching symbols so you can find tools, insights, and charts at a glance. - The activity calendar fits the window and expands the hovered date, while chart highlights respond immediately and floating details wait for the pointer to settle. - The subagent card includes Antigravity usage from synced Macs, and the tool ranking shows separate figures for Antigravity App and CLI.
## Fixes
- Subagent rows with local activity keep their hover highlight and stay expandable while synced totals and details refresh. - Weekday and hourly bars in Coding patterns highlight immediately, with the readout appearing after a short pause. - Antigravity launches sync across Macs even when a subagent stops before using any tokens. - In the combined Overview, expanded Antigravity conversations use the same dates as the totals. - Clicking the expanded edge of a date in the activity calendar opens the same day shown by the pointer. - Overview, Records, and Speed reload their data after you restore a backup. - Records and This Mac only offer Retry when the full local report fails to load. - The refresh button keeps showing progress while a manual scan waits for an incremental scan to finish. - Turning off Follow pointer keeps the HUD on the display where it is currently visible.
